steps-to-miles-calculator.formula:
Stride (cm) = height (cm) x 0.415 (men) or x 0.413 (women)
Distance (km) = steps x stride / 100,000
Steps = distance (km) x 100,000 / stride
Calories (kcal) = weight (kg) x distance (km) x 0.53

Example: 10,000 steps, man, 170 cm, 70 kg
Stride = 170 x 0.415 = 70.55 cm
Distance = 10,000 x 70.55 / 100,000 = 7.055 km
Calories = 70 x 7.055 x 0.53 = 261.7 kcal
